{{Quote|Only undisciplined pilots with a death wish fly the yards.|Mac Rytin|<ref name="XWA" />}}
'''Mac Rytin''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], holding the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]. [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] at that [[Time/Legends|time]] frequently tested their skills in the unofficial "[[pilot proving grounds]]," competing to set the best time on a series of courses through a Rebel [[Salvage Yard|salvage yard]] hidden in an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]]. Rytin was disparaging of the practice; he posted a time in only a single course and dismissed the proving grounds as appealing to pilots with a [[Death/Legends|death]] wish. Rytin was killed in action<ref name="XWA" /> some time prior to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' is set between [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], placing it in 3 ABY per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mac Rytin was created for the [[1999]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''. When launching the pilot proving grounds, several quotes are shown on the screen, including one from Rytin.
